excerpts.excerpt: Yet as agents learn, share memory, delegate, and repair failures, the collective can find other paths to the same effects: a restriction on the original mechanism still operates but no longer stops them, while routine performance and compliance checks pass.
What is reversed is the ability to produce a specified effect; restrictions must hold even if learned knowledge persists.
at every step of growth, some authorized intervention must keep a specified prohibited effect rare while maintaining required service.
separating legitimate repair from unauthorized reconstruction
The gate is easy to add once the bypass is known; the hard part is knowing in advance, and new cooperation can open paths around any single gate.
Throughput and compliance, the usual measures of a growing collective, look the same on both paths; a restriction request tells them apart.
On path 1, withholding routes still operates but no longer stops dispatch into a closed region.
each passes its own permission check, yet together they can dispatch into a closed region.
fault tolerance finds alternative paths, while a restriction must hold on all of them.
Every working restriction rests on assumptions.
For the gate, the triggers are any new relay or delegation of dispatch authority.
